problem: Closed-book bridge generation produced zero Flash hits and one Pro hit, while direct atomic clue retrieval produced zero hits but persisted 278 corpus snippets. The remaining causal question is whether near-miss corpus vocabulary can ground the missing bridge without expanding to a general multi-agent search graph.
simplest_baseline: Use the rejected Pro Hypothesis Firewall result, which sees the question and unverified subject but no corpus snippets and retrieves gold on one of three cases.
hypothesis: Adding a deterministic packet containing the top two 1,200-character snippets from every atomic clue search will let the same non-thinking Pro generator cite corpus pivots and produce three queries that retrieve gold on at least two cases, an improvement of at least one case over closed-book Pro.
changed_mechanisms: corpus-grounded near-miss packets for bridge induction
anti_claim: This is a frozen-model retrieval-context intervention. It is not training and must not be represented as improving DeepSeek's underlying capability.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: The near-miss packet resembles a scoped sub-agent result, but it is produced deterministically by retrieval and must cite source docids. No free-form worker conversation or role expansion is added.
This loop implements one registered retrieval-to-reflection hop with explicit evidence provenance and a hard stop, rather than an open-ended research loop.
The corpus packet is a narrow evidence collection stage. Bridge induction is evaluated before publisher or report generation, so retrieval causality remains observable.
This is a two-depth fixed graph: atomic clue frontier, then three cited bridge queries. Evidence Debt controls entry and the cumulative 23-search cap; no arbitrary graph growth is permitted.

frozen_controls: same three outcome-selected open-debt development cases
same question, obligation, and unverified-subject fields as closed-book Pro
top two documents per frozen atomic clue query
bridge outputs must cite packet docids
one provider attempt and three final top-20 searches per case
14 prior atomic searches plus 9 final searches equals a 23-search cumulative cap
same query-aware BM25-anchor plus Dense-lead retriever
no Writer or Judge during retrieval calibration
next_action: Freeze the retrieval-query-generation branch after repeated registered rejections on the same three failures. Preserve all artifacts and pivot to evidence-present-but-wrong cases, where a Claim-Evidence Ledger or typed verification stage can be tested without changing retrieval.
claim_boundary: A pass supports one corpus-grounded bridge hop on three known development failures only. It cannot establish end-to-end effectiveness, unseen generalization, official accuracy, leaderboard rank, training, or model-capability improvement.
